sections.label: Deputy Speakers elected in Parliament
sections.summary: Mr Christopher de Souza and Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo are declared duly elected as Deputy Speakers of this Parliament.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: One of Mr de Souza’s notable contributions was the introduction of a Private Member’s Bill – Prevention of Human Trafficking Bill – in October 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: He also served as Chairman of the Government Parliamentary Committee for Home Affairs and Law from 2015 to 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: Over the years, she has made significant contributions as a Member of this House, serving as Chairman of the Public Accounts Committee from 2016 to 2020 and as Chairman for the Government Parliamentary Committee for Finance, Trade and Industry from 2010 to 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: I am confident that both Mr Christopher de Souza and Ms Jessica Tan, with their expertise, experience and character, will make good deputies in discharging their duties and support Mr Speaker in the course of this Fourteenth Parliament session.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: There being no other proposal, I declare Mr Christopher de Souza and Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo to have been duly elected as Deputy Speakers of this Parliament.
